name: Muse Spaces
summary: Build a client hub, order tracker, or simple game by describing it in Muse. These interactive spaces live inside the app, can update from connected services, and are available wherever Muse is offered.

name: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
summary: Create 15-second product videos with sound, then change backgrounds or lighting through follow-up prompts. Available in the Gemini API at $0.07 per second for 720p, with no-cost video generation also rolling out in Google Vids.

name: Inkling 2 Small
summary: Build websites, games, and visual prototypes with a model that uses image feedback to refine its work. Available in Tinker Playground and for fine-tuning today, with downloadable weights still pending.

name: Images 2.6
summary: Turn prompts, photos, or sketches into animated GIFs, export SVGs, and mark up exactly which parts of an image to change. About 50% faster, rolling out in ChatGPT and Codex, with Flare and Sunburst models in the API.

name: Teammates
summary: Delegate ongoing market research, bug investigations, or marketing work to agents that remember project history and bring results back for review. Available on the web for individual Max subscribers, with connections to tools such as GitHub and Gmail.

name: Gemini Computer Use
summary: Build agents that test web apps, fill forms, and control desktop or mobile interfaces from screenshots. Now generally available through the Gemini API, with sample code for connecting it to your own browser automation.

name: Local Code
summary: Run a private coding and office agent on your Mac that writes code and edits spreadsheets and docs with no sign-in or API key. Free and open source, using local Qwen or DeepSeek models downloaded inside the app.

name: H3 Flex
summary: Generate short videos with synced stereo sound from text, images, or reference clips in about six steps. Open weights on Hugging Face run locally at up to 768p, with 1080p and 4K through Pika's API.
